$comment: The rules modules can bring; each goes to .claude/rules/<name>. Each entry says where it comes from: `install` (a command; it runs when a path in `output` is missing, and those paths go when no module needs the entry any more), `copy` (a file or folder in library/, copied whole) or `template` (a file in template/, which Copier renders and merges with the project's edits). An entry with none of these is written by another entry's `install` (listed in its `output`). `frameworks` (if any) lists the frameworks it fits; elsewhere it is left out.

structure.md.describe: where new and moved files go.

feature-workflow.md.describe: the steps for building a user-facing feature.

performance.md.describe: how pages load fast and how to measure it (loads when working in `app/` or `lib/`).

tests-unit.md.describe: unit test conventions (loads when working on test files).

tests-e2e.md.describe: end-to-end test conventions (loads when working in `tests/`).

context7.md.describe: fetch current library docs through Context7 before answering library questions.
